### Recent Releases

<ul>
<li>
  <strong>2026-11-10</strong> – <a href="https://github.com/insin/control-panel-for-twitter">control-panel-for-twitter</a> <a href="https://github.com/insin/control-panel-for-twitter/releases/tag/v4.99.0-preview.1">v4.99.0-preview.1</a>
  <div><em>Browser extension which gives you more control over your Twitter timeline and adds missing features and UI improvements - for desktop and mobile</em></div>
  <details><summary>v4.99.0-preview.1 release notes</summary><p>Preview build of the next version of Control Panel for Twitter, which will support the <a href="https://blog.x.com/en/engineering/rebuilding-the-global-town-square-from-scratch" rel="nofollow">rewrite of the UI which X are rolling out</a>.</p>
<h2>Installing</h2>
<p>This preview version installs separately from the store version and uses its own settings.</p>
<p><strong>Disable the version you installed from an extension store while using it</strong> to prevent the two versions fighting with eachother.</p>
<h2>Chrome and other Chromium-based browsers</h2>
<ul>
<li>Download <code>control_panel_for_twitter-4.99.0.preview-chromium.mv3.zip</code> (from Assets below) and extract it into a folder</li>
<li>Follow <a href="https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/get-started/tutorial/hello-world#load-unpacked" rel="nofollow">Chrome's instructions for loading an unpacked extension</a></li>
<li>Select the extracted folder containing <code>manifest.json</code> when prompted.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Firefox</h2>
<ul>
<li>Download <code>control_panel_for_twitter-4.99.0.preview-firefox.mv2.zip</code> (from Assets below)</li>
<li>Follow <a href="https://extensionworkshop.com/documentation/develop/temporary-installation-in-firefox/" rel="nofollow">Mozilla's temporary installation instructions</a></li>
<li>Select the downloaded ZIP file when prompted.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Temporary extensions are removed when Firefox restarts</strong>, so you'll need to do this again any time you close all your Firefox windows.</p></details>
</li>
